snippet.title: [Full Album] LO-FI Bespoke Serenity- House Rulez(하우스룰즈)
snippet.description:
하우스룰즈가 선사하는 프라이빗한 휴식, [LOFI Bespoke Serenity]

하우스룰즈 유튜브 채널에 꾸준히 공개되어 사랑을 받아온 Lo-Fi 음원들이
마침내 하나의 앨범으로 완성되다.룰즈 특유의 세련되고 트렌디한 터치가 더해진 로우파이 사운드, 
기분 좋은 릴렉스가 필요한 당신의 시간을 채워보세요.

✨Track List
1.Trust
2.First Date (feat.Annie)
3.Beauty Snow
4.Mashmellow
5.Silent Tree
6.Remedy
7.Summer Tape Rewind
8.Shill Harmony
9.Star Reflection


✨CREDITS

Produced by Seoro (House Rulez)  
Lyrics by Annie
Music Composed & Arranged by Seoro (House Rulez)    
Keyboard, Sax by Seoro  
Sound Mixed by Daisuke Imagane
Mastered by Adam Grover 
Excutive produced by Aftermoon Music

Emotions in a word known as "time."

Past happy moments, worrying about the future, or the anticipation and the excitement of it makes our day pass by without even noticing it.

Furthermore, as much as we desire a simple happiness, we also experience sadness from an unexpected incident.
So the existence of "time," seems like an odd sensibility in a sequence of events like this.

“Tic Tok” is a song which will make you feel like you are reading an emotional essay.
How will the time of our future flow?

snippet.title: TIC TOK (feat.Cheryl Sekiya) -  House Rulez(하우스룰즈)
snippet.description:
잠시 멈추고 돌아보는 시간이 필요한 “순간”

“시간”에 담긴 감성. 아는 만큼 보이는 세상.
때론 본질을 이해하지 못해도 느낌만으로 행복해하는
그 순간들과, 미래의 걱정 또는 기대와 설렘으로 
하루하루 어떻게 지나가는지 모를 정도로 바쁨 속에서
때론 순간의 소박한 행복을 찾다가도 별의별 사건 속에서
슬픔을 느끼기도 하는 패턴의 연속인 오묘한 “시간”

한편의 감성 에세이와도 같은 알쏭달쏭 한 노래 “Tic Tok”
시간은 어디로 흘러가는 걸까

한겨울 칠아웃 라운지 하우스로 편하게 시작하는 하우스룰즈의 신곡.
기타리스트 “Traver”가 맴버로 영입된 하우스룰즈 2020의 첫 시작을 
알리는 싱글트랙 공개!
[melon]http://kko.to/g8p3wjejH

When I need a "moment" to pause and look back.
Emotions in a word known as "time."
Depending on our knowledge, the world may look different.
Sometimes we don't quite understand the essence(nature), but we are happy with the feeling.
Past happy moments, worrying about the future, or the anticipation and the excitement of it makes our day pass by without even noticing it.

Furthermore, as much as we desire a simple happiness, we also experience sadness from an unexpected incident.
So the existence of "time," seems like an odd sensibility in a sequence of events like this.

“Tic Tok” is a song which will make you feel like you are reading an emotional essay.
How will the time of our future flow?

starting with a lounge with calm, winter like emotions
